403.title: You do not have permission to access this feature.
403.message: If you believe this is a mistake, please contact the system administrator.

404.title: Content Not Found
404.message: The content related to this notification no longer exists or the URL is incorrect.

invalidAccount.title: Account Not Configured
invalidAccount.message: Your account has not been assigned a valid role.
invalidAccount.instruction: Please contact the Admin or system management team to be assigned the correct role.

boundary.title: An error occurred while loading the screen
boundary.message: Please try again or return to the dashboard.

api.CAMPUS_REQUIRED: Please select a campus before signing in.
api.CAMPUS_MISMATCH: Your account does not have access to the selected campus. Please choose the campus you are authorized for.
api.PORTAL_MISMATCH: This account is not allowed to sign in through the current portal. Please check that you are using the right portal.
api.INTERNAL_ACCOUNT_NOT_FOUND: Your account has not been created in the internal system. Please contact your Staff Leader or campus administrator to be granted access.
api.PASSWORD_LOGIN_DISABLED: Password sign-in is disabled. Please use SSO/FEID.
api.ACCOUNT_LOCKED: Your account is locked. Please try again later or contact an administrator.
api.FEID_NOT_CONFIGURED: FEID sign-in is not available yet. Please use another method or contact an administrator.
api.FEID_NOT_ELIGIBLE: Your FEID account is not eligible to sign in. Please contact an administrator.
api.EXTERNAL_AUTH_FAILED: Unable to sign in with this account. Please try again.
api.VISITOR_PROVISION_DISABLED: Automatic Visitor account creation is not enabled.
api.SESSION_REVOKED: Your session has been revoked. Please sign in again.
api.TOKEN_EXPIRED: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.
api.UNAUTHORIZED: You need to sign in to continue.
api.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR: A system error occurred. Please try again later.
api.CAMPUS_MANAGEMENT_FORBIDDEN: You do not have permission to manage campuses.
api.CAMPUS_ACTIVATION_MASTER_DATA_INCOMPLETE: Cannot activate the campus because required information is missing (code, name, site, address, phone, email).
api.CAMPUS_ACTIVATION_MISSING_IC_DEPARTMENT: Cannot activate the campus because it has no active IC department.
api.CAMPUS_ADDRESS_ALREADY_EXISTS: This address is already used by another campus.
api.CAMPUS_PHONE_ALREADY_EXISTS: This phone number is already used by another campus.
api.CAMPUS_EMAIL_ALREADY_EXISTS: This email is already used by another campus.
api.PROFILE_FORBIDDEN_FIELD: The request contains fields that cannot be updated.
api.PROFILE_PHONE_INVALID: Invalid phone number. Please enter 8–15 digits.
api.CONTACT_EMAIL_CANNOT_BE_USED_FOR_VISITOR: This contact email cannot be used to create a Visitor account. Please use a different email.
api.VISITOR_ACCOUNT_INACTIVE: The Visitor account linked to this email is deactivated. Please contact an administrator.
